text:
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER led TW at £8,406.79 revenue (13.6% share, Rank 1), up 70.1% WoW from £4,942.19 LW, with units rising from 1,851 LW to 3,172 TW.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS posted the steepest WoW decline, £2,143.03 TW versus £5,604.38 LW (-61.8%), with orders down from 84 LW to 49 TW.
- The three Edwardian Parasol lines combined for £9,139.25 TW versus £9,454.25 LW: BLACK £3,448.60 (-12.2% WoW), NATURAL £2,935.10 (+21.7% WoW), RED £2,755.55 (-11.5% WoW).
- Hot water bottle lines totalled £12,111.00 TW across seven entities, with CHICK GREY HOT WATER BOTTLE +155.1% WoW to £1,076.30 and GREY HEART HOT WATER BOTTLE +126.7% WoW to £1,394.46.
- BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME (+185.5% WoW to £1,144.96) and WILLOW BRANCH LIGHTS. (+185.0% WoW to £1,033.11) recorded the two largest percentage gains TW, ranking 24 and 30 respectively.
- WHITE CHERRY LIGHTS fell 54.1% WoW to £1,213.62 TW and PINK CHERRY LIGHTS fell 42.1% WoW to £1,130.42 TW, a combined £2,250.35 decrease from LW.
- FAIRY CAKE CANDLES rose 121.8% WoW to £3,065.02 TW at Rank 3, with units up from 997 LW to 2,318 TW, while ANTIQUE SILVER TEA GLASS ETCHED rose 110.2% WoW to £1,527.93 TW on 1,265 units.
- LY revenue is blank for all 30 products in ISO week 2009-W50, so no YoY percent change is available for any row.
